package app

trait Handler { def handle(s: String): Unit }

class Service(repo: Repo.type) extends Handler {
  override def handle(s: String): Unit = { audit(s) }
  private def audit(s: String): Unit = repo.save(s)
  private def unusedPrivate(): Int = 1
  def unusedPublic(): Int = 2
}

class Orphan extends Handler {
  def handle(s: String): Unit = ()
}
